cc:Work.dc:title: Who issued the certificates we observed?
cc:Work.dc:description: Who issued the certificates we observed. DigiCert: 158 of 712 (22.2%); Google Trust Services: 134 of 712 (18.8%); Let's Encrypt: 121 of 712 (17.0%); Amazon Trust Services: 97 of 712 (13.6%); GlobalSign: 78 of 712 (11.0%); Sectigo: 52 of 712 (7.3%); All other issuers: 72 of 712 (10.1%). One vantage point on 18 Sep 2026. No certificate observed for 288 domains; not an internet-wide estimate.
